units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 40">Ex. R. s. 40</cite>, end <he>לעולם … מניח בִּצְרוֹ</he> one should never give up his trade; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 6:1">Pesik. R. s. 6</cite>, end <he>מחליף בְּצִירוֹ</he> (<cite ref="Arakhin 16a">Arakh. 16</cite> <he>אומנותו ואומנות אבותיו</he>). Ex. R. l. c. (insert <cite ref="Job 22:24-25">Job XXII, 24—25</cite> as text) the Lord says, <he>אני הוא בִצְרְכֶן … בִצְרָן וכ׳</he> I am your support, give ye never up your support (faith); but also the support of your fathers ye must not give up (labor) &c. Pesik. R. l. c. thou art our God <he>ובְצִירֵנוּ</he> and our support (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 95:6">Ps. XCV, 6</cite>).

senses.gloss: pl. בְּצָרִים fort. Ex. R. l. c. (ref. to Job l. c.; cmp. Targ.) שנעשה חומותיך He will be thy fortification. [Yalk. Deut. 811, v. בִּיצּוּר.]
